## First beta

- Opens KamTape XL, KamTape's TV interface, in the PS5 browser when the app starts (can be turned off in Settings)
- Opens the full KamTape site
- Go to a page: type any KamTape address with the system keyboard
- Keeps your last five pages under Recent pages
- Settings for start-up, interface sounds and clearing recent pages

## Install

- Unzip PPSA52005.zip and copy the PPSA52005 folder to /data/homebrew/ on the console, or install it from ProsperoStore
- Needs a PS5 that runs homebrew apps and an internet connection

## Known limits

- Beta: not yet tested on a real PS5
- Unofficial app, not made or endorsed by KamTape
